*.name: Display name for this power (optional; overrides the default).
*.hidden: If true, this power is not listed on the origin screen.
*.condition: Only applies while this condition passes (a DSL condition object — use pick). On power types without their own condition field, a top-level condition is an alias for power_condition with mode ALLOW.
*.power_condition: Whole-power gate: an entity condition re-evaluated whenever the power would act (works on every power type). Pair with power_condition_mode.
*.power_condition_mode: How power_condition gates: ALLOW = power active while the condition is true; DENY (default) = power disabled while the condition is true.
*.cooldown_icon: Cooldown-gated active (keybind) powers only. Optional HUD cooldown icon: an item id (e.g. 'minecraft:ender_pearl') rendered as the item, or a datapack texture path ending in '.png' (resolved under assets/<namespace>/textures/) drawn 16x16. When set, the HUD swaps this power's cooldown bar for the icon with a clock-style radial sweep; empty (default) keeps the plain bar.
*.cooldown_countdown: Cooldown-gated active (keybind) powers only. If true, the remaining cooldown in whole seconds is drawn translucently on the cooldown_icon (default true). Only applies when cooldown_icon is set; players can suppress all countdown numbers via the show_cooldown_countdown client config and tune the text opacity via the cooldown_countdown_opacity client config.
*.always_show_icon: Cooldown-gated active (keybind) and toggleable powers. If true, this power's cooldown_icon stays on the ability HUD cluster even while the power is idle / off cooldown (default false: idle icons disappear). Only applies when cooldown_icon is set; players can force this for every power via the always_show_ability_icons client config.

origin.spawn_location: Preferred first-spawn / respawn placement filter (LocationCondition shape). dimension / structure / structure_tag combine with AND; biome / biome_tag / biomes combine with OR (any biome match passes). Optional extras: allow_water_surface, allow_ocean_floor (default false), min_y, max_y, can_see_sky. Resolved server-side; the teleport fires once, on the player's first origin pick.
origin.tier_powers: Evolution-tier power overlays: array of {tier, add, remove} objects. tier (required, min 1) is the evolution tier; at that tier, power ids in add are granted and ids in remove are revoked. Overlays stack cumulatively — tier 2 includes tier 1's changes.

origin_layer.allow_random: If true, this layer participates in random-origin assignment (default false).
origin_layer.auto_choose: If true, the layer auto-selects when only one origin is available, skipping its picker screen (default false).
origin_layer.condition: Object-entry form: layer condition gating the entry's visibility — origins:/neoorigins:origin ({layer, origin, inverted}) or and/or over sub-conditions. Tests the player's choices in OTHER layers, not a DSL entity condition.
origin_layer.default_origin: Origin ID auto-assigned when the layer is resolved without a player choice (optional).
origin_layer.enabled: If false, the layer is loaded but skipped by the picker (default true).
origin_layer.hidden: If true, the layer is resolved but never shown as a picker tab (default false).
origin_layer.origin: Object-entry form: the origin ID this entry offers (required when the entry is an object).
origin_layer.origins: Ordered list of origin entries (required, min 1). Each entry is a plain origin ID string, or an object {origin, condition} whose layer condition gates visibility based on choices made in other layers. First entry is the default selection.
origin_layer.replace: If true, this file fully replaces earlier definitions of the same layer ID from lower-priority datapacks; default false = merge (origins append + dedup).

neoorigins:active_ability.resource_cost: Power id of a neoorigins:resource debited on activation; empty = no resource cost. If the player can't afford it the activation silently aborts (no cooldown consumed). When resource bars are globally disabled (disable_resource_bars), the cost falls back to hunger instead (resource_cost_amount food points).
neoorigins:active_ability.resource_cost_amount: Resource points deducted per successful activation (default 0; only used when resource_cost is set). Checked pre-flight — activation silently aborts if the current value is below this.

neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.drain_rate: (legacy) Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; higher = slower (20 = 1s, default).
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.air_loss_per_second: Air points lost per second while submerged. Higher = faster drain. Overrides drain_interval_ticks / drain_rate when set.

neoorigins:effect_immunity.effects: List of mob-effect ids whose application to the player is cancelled.

neoorigins:particle.frequency: Emit every N ticks (20 = 1s; default 8, min 1).
neoorigins:particle.offset: [x,y,z] offset in blocks from the player to spawn at (default [0,1,0]).
neoorigins:particle.particle: Particle id, or object form like {type:minecraft:dust,color,scale}.
neoorigins:particle.speed: Particle motion speed passed to the spawn call (default 0.0 = still).

neoorigins:raycast.before_action: EntityAction run once on the actor before the ray is cast, regardless of hit outcome (e.g. consume a reagent).
neoorigins:raycast.command_at_hit: Optional command run at the precise impact point when the ray hits a block or entity; not run on a miss.

neoorigins:resource.color: Hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for the HUD resource bar fill.
neoorigins:resource.hidden: If true, the HUD bar is not rendered but the resource still ticks, regens and can be spent (default false). Also forced true by hud_render.should_render=false (Origins compat).
neoorigins:resource.label: Display name shown on the HUD resource bar (e.g. "Mana").
neoorigins:resource.max: Maximum value the resource can hold (default 100).
neoorigins:resource.max_action: EntityAction run once when the resource rises to its max.
neoorigins:resource.min: Minimum value the resource can drop to (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.min_action: EntityAction run once when the resource falls to its min.
neoorigins:resource.regen_condition: EntityCondition that must pass for regen to apply (default always).
neoorigins:resource.regen_interval: Ticks between regen ticks (20 = 1s; default 20, min 1).
neoorigins:resource.regen_rate: Amount added each regen interval; 0 disables regen (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.start_value: Value the resource starts at when first granted (default max).

neoorigins:starting_equipment.components: Singular shape: SNBT data-component patch applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.count: Singular shape: stack size of the granted item (default 1).
neoorigins:starting_equipment.enchantments: Singular shape: list of {id, level} enchantments applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.grant_id: Unique id tracked so the bundle is granted only once per player. Dedups the whole power, not individual stacks.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.item: Singular shape: item id granted once after the player commits their origin. Optional when `stacks` is provided.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.legacy_tag: Singular shape: Apoli-style flat SNBT translated into data components on the item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.stacks: Plural shape (v2.2.0): array of stack entries, each with the same per-stack fields as the singular shape (item, count, enchantments, legacy_tag, components). When non-empty, takes precedence over the singular root fields and N items are granted in array order.
